fields.label: Text on this copy
fields.description: For example "Customer Copy". Leave empty to print the copy without a label.

fields.label: Show Side Dishes
fields.description: Print on this copy the side dishes changed from the recipe (with / without), as on the kitchen ticket. Usually on for the restaurant copy, off for the customer copy. Extra portions billed always print, and the order tick Print Sides on the Receipt prints them on every copy.
